title: I made a first-person parkour slasher with Claude and CC0 art: grapple, directional cuts, and duels against your own build
author: Cornmills
selftext:
HookSlash started in Godot and was rebuilt in Unity 6. I directed and playtested it. Claude wrote the code, including the city generator, the procedural weapon and much of the tooling. The characters and animation are Quaternius CC0 assets and most of the music is CC0.

Where AI struggled: things that compile and look fine to a test but not to a person. My first browser release shipped with an invisible sword hilt, because one shader assumed desktop depth. The killcam was broken too. Neither produced an error. I now check the live page by hand before every release.

Free in the browser: [https://kamalakj.itch.io/hookslash](https://kamalakj.itch.io/hookslash)

Happy to answer anything about the process.
